title: Data Readiness for AI: A 360-Degree Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveys statistical fairness metrics such as Difference metrics, Disparate Impact (Likelihood Ratio), representation rates, and divergence metrics (e.g., Kullback-Leibler, Jensen-Shannon, Total Variation Distance) to measure disparities and discrimination across sensitive demographic attributes in structured data.

Reviews class imbalance metrics like Imbalance Ratio (IR), Imbalance Degree (ID), and Likelihood Ratio Imbalance Degree (LRID) to quantify skewed or uneven distributions of instances among different categories.

Surveys bias indicators for unstructured textual data, specifically highlighting techniques that use word embeddings and cosine similarity calculations to quantify associations and identify biases related to gender, race, religion, and other sensitive attributes.
